title: The Signal
summary: A repeating broadcast from somewhere in the wastes. Someone is transmitting — or something automated is. Either way, people are noticing, and at least one powerful person wants it investigated quietly.

stages.title: Investigate the Broadcast
stages.description: Ask around Haven Ridge. Someone knows more than they're saying.

objectives.text: Talk to Ava Chen about the signal
Ask Councilman Falk what the Council knows

stages.title: Find the Signal's Source
stages.description: The signal appears to originate from the old Silo Complex east of the Scrapfield. Get there.

stages.title: Silence the Silo
stages.description: The Iron Covenant has the silo locked down. Getting to the antenna means going through them.

objectives.text: Deal with the Iron Covenant forces at the silo
